I am sitting at my desk feeling weak with shaky hands due to not eating anything except 4 soggy old crumpets since our last breakfast together on Saturday, my mind hazy from the cocktail of various benzodiazepines the doctors have given me, to quell my anxiety and help me to sleep for more that 2 hours at a time, I am wondering to myself; should I be writing this down?

We met in early 2010 the dank and smelly confines of the decrepit college city campus campus. I was anxious, preoccupied in my own thoughts of self doubt. Why have I decided law? I'm too stupid to be here, I don't belong here with these people, these high achievers, they seem to get it. I don't even know what on earth the teacher is talking about. I tried to read my contract law textbook to make sense of it all. It may as well have been written in Portuguese for all the sense it was making to me. It was all too hard for my simple mind, I was close to chucking it in. “Give it a few more weeks”, my mom encouraged me over the phone, “it will start to make sense”, she promised. My mom believed in me and I didn't want to disappoint her, so I promised myself that I'd keep going.

The next week, I seem to remember that I was late to class, having been stuck in yet another dreary meeting at my dead end job in the finance department at a non nondescript company . I hurried into the class room, I plonked down into a desk in the front row near the door, I noticed that I was sitting next to this girl, X was her name, as I had learnt from Y an anxious and peculiar girl in the same class had mentioned her to me in passing. You were confident, bright and asked a lot of questions. You seemed to understand the class, I wished that I was intelligent as you. During that class we chatted and joked. I remember joking and trying to purchase copies of your study notes for a quarter cents. You were funny, kind, intelligent and very beautiful. We clicked and soon became friends. I started to look forward to class, so that we could spend time together and chat and joke. I had made a new great friend and it felt great. Suddenly my homesickness and longing for the white sandy beaches of my home town had gone.

Soon after the first exam period approached. I was worried that I would fail. But we had agreed to meet in the library and study together. We pushed each other to keep studying, with the reward of breaks to local restaurants or the ice cream store for an ice cream. With my new friend by my side I began to feel like we could do it. We could get through the exams and then possibly survive the whole degree. I don't know when or how exactly, but gradually our friendship began to change into something more. We begun spending more time together and we arranged to go together for a dinner at Renzo's, my favorite restaurant. I remember meeting you near the station. As we made the short walk across the bridge spanning the river, I remembering thinking to myself I'm really happy, the happiest that I have been in a long time. Soon you were coming over to the apartment that I shared with my childhood friend, B and spending the night and I was spending the night at your apartment as well. I was overjoyed that we were become a couple. We clicked, we joked and laughed all the time, it felt perfect.

One day we were cooking a curry chicken together it hit me. I was in love with you, I'd finally found my soul mate.

I asked you to move into an apartment together. I was overjoyed and we move into our little apartment together. What followed were the happiest days of my life. I was with my love, my sole mate. Life didn't feel to bad after all. I'd drop you off in the city and listen to you sing and joke on the way in to the city. On weekends, we would go out for breakfast, go to the library, the campus, shop together or go for a walk and the gym. We were making progress, I started to understand the study materials a bit better, my grads were improving and so were yours.

Sure there were hard times, I told you about my credit card troubles and depression. You told me about your traffic fines and problems paying college fees. We stuck together and got through it. I worked and paid the bills as best as I could. Surviving such adversities together resolved my love for you. I thought we were life partners, working together through everything for better or worse. When I was feeling stressed and anxious you booked a holiday. It felt great to be with someone who cared. We went to Mexico together and it was the best holiday of my life.

Soon I started to notice a change. We had moved to the suburbs and you seemed to loose your spark. I was worried that you had depression and that made me feel sad. We went for another holiday to Laos and China and you seemed down and didn't want to be there for the whole trip. I began to be worried that my suspicion was correct and that you were depressed. Having been there I know how awful it can be to have depression, I promised myself that I would try to help you as best I could.

You left for another city to work and asked me to follow you there. While I was looking for work, would call me nearly everyday upset or crying. I knew you were depressed and wanted to help you. You stayed with my parents and I took you to the doctor. I missed you when you were gone and wanted to be with you the whole time. It was hard to be so far away from you. I got a job in my home town and hoped that you would follow and we could settle in my home town and get your spark back. I missed my old partner. Things didn't work out in my home town and we spent the last 18 months or so living together in back in the city.

Living in the city was hard. The apartment was small and cramped. But it was the best we could get. I tried to pay for everything and support you with depression. I just wanted you to get better, I took you to the counsellor. You started to take calls from you dad downstairs, was spending most of your time on your mobile texting and took lots of trips to China, I now suspect to be with him. You were cheating. I was so naïve, I was stressed and sad because you were depressed, and I wanted to get through it with you, together like we always seemed to. But you must not have cared anymore. But now I feel like you didn't care about me. I became your cheap accommodation and emotional crutch in in out home city and that was it.

When we moved to a bigger apartment, thing seems like that were starting to get better. I started to feel like my old partner was coming back and that she would be back to her full strength anytime soon. I was positive and happy. I thought we had turned a corner and life was getting back on track. Until, on Saturday when I saw the text messages and I know why you seems better and it makes me feel sick. How could my sole mate, the love of my life who I though I would be spending the rest of my life with turn out to be such a fake, manipulative, lying, sleazy person? I've never been overcome with such strong emotions before. It was awful, it is going to take me a very long time to recover from what you have done. As you know, I've battled depression for the past 10 years. Sometimes I'm OK, other days I am not. But it never leaves me. So I'm glad my mom was there with me Saturday, what I found out about you tipped me over the edge. On Sunday, I had an acute mental health break down and my body was paralyzed with anxiety and shock. For a short time, I could not even see. mom had to call an ambulance to take me to the hospital. I've been having anxiety attacks every 6 to 10 hours since and need to take Valium to keep me calm, sleeping pills to get me to sleep. I'm also back on antidepressants and will be going to a psychiatrist soon, because my depression and anxiety is back worst than ever. But this time I've promised myself I'm going to beat it for good!

My mom and family are devastated by what has happened. They loved you and though of you as family. They welcomed you to my cousin's wedding, my sisters wedding, my mom's 60th birthday party and Christmases. My mom and aunty took you out for your 30th birthday lunch. They thought you were so special and they were proud of us as a couple. You have betrayed them.

I don't know how long you were lying and cheating. I don't really care. Frankly, once is enough. I was loyal to you to a fault and you have treated me with utter contempt.

If you didn't feel “chemistry”, you should have just told me. I never stopped loving you. Not for 1 second, that is, until Saturday. We could have tried to work it out, I know I would have not hesitated to do whatever was needed and if we couldn't fix things, we could have broken up. It would have hurt and we would have both been sad. But we could have worked through and remained as close friends, if that is what we wanted to do.

Sometimes I know was grumpy to you or said things that hurt your feelings and for that I am sorry.

I hope take away from this that being a manipulative, selfish, lying sleaze bag will always catch up with you in end.

I want you to promise to yourself that you will never to anything like this to anyone ever again. I want you strive to be honest and selfless in your future relationships.

I think that you should tell whoever you are seeing in now that you were living with someone else and deal with the consequences now. Don't start something new on a foundation of lies and deceit.

Please spend more time with your family. They are the only family you have now. Your father is a sweet, kind and generous man. Your mother is a hard working woman who loves her kids. You need you spend more time with them and try to become more like them, a better person.

Become the person that I thought you were, not the person that you are.
